basis: The UK Planning Inspectorate publishes the Planning Inspectorate Casework Database on GOV.UK as bulk open data (Casework_Database_-_2610.xlsx and Older_Casework_Data_-_2610.xlsx, the 2026-10-22 edition, sha256 dff80bd0f17cbc640dc205009a9411269c8e58462b6df71af903c592af3c20fa and baf28d80c5cd5ad266f8a9e62c25517b2ec9d4c5d951239ab0638666bc092a4b). The publication's data-notes page states 'This publication is licensed under the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated' and the publication page carries the Open Government Licence emblem with 'Crown copyright 2026'; both instruments were read 2026-10-31 and are quoted in the candidate record's license_evidence. No dataset-specific restriction is stated on either page. OGL-UK v3.0 grants a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, non-exclusive licence to copy, publish, distribute, transmit, adapt and commercially exploit the information, with attribution and the same-licence condition for adapted versions of official material. Class A (explicit open licence permitting redistribution and derivatives with attribution), so the standing defaults apply: our code and documentation are MIT, our rights in the derived compilation are dedicated CC0-1.0, and the source's own terms are preserved, never relicensed.

compilation.scope: Our contribution - the s78_core eligibility frame (planning-permission-family casework with a binary Allowed/Dismissed decision), the counted exclusions (non-binary decisions, cross-file composite duplicates, decided-before-validation rows), the derived binary label from the publisher's Decision field, the derived date-gap and calendar features, the site-descriptor and designation flags, the LPA prior-outcome history features computed strictly from decisions earlier than the row's validation instant, the validation-instant temporal partition, and the packaging - is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. The dedication covers only our contribution: the underlying Planning Inspectorate Casework Database keeps its own designation and remains subject to the Open Government Licence v3.0, whose attribution condition carries through to every copy of the derived data. Nothing here relicenses the source or presents CC0 as the source's terms.

source.status: Planning Inspectorate Casework Database (GOV.UK publication 'Planning Inspectorate Casework Database', 2026-10-22 edition) under the Open Government Licence v3.0: free to copy, publish, distribute, transmit, adapt and exploit commercially with the required attribution statement. OGL-UK exempts personal data, third-party rights and official symbols from its grant; the shipped columns were chosen with that in mind: the publisher's inspector-name field is excluded by design (post-instant and corrected for data errors by the publisher in 2025), no free-text applicant or site-occupier identity ships, and the LPA name/ONS code, casework type, procedure, development type, appeal reason fields, site descriptors and flags are redistributed exactly as the publisher publishes them, with nothing added beyond our derived binary label, the derived date/calendar features, the LPA prior-outcome history features, the eligibility frame, the deduplication and the partition. The derived dataset is labelled as such throughout and is not the Planning Inspectorate's official product. The publisher's own caveats carry through unchanged: some categorisation of appeals can be subjective; the data can change between different publications of this dataset; the extract covers decided cases only (in progress, withdrawn and turned away cases are not included); Local Plans Examination rows were removed by the publisher from the current Casework Database; TPO valid dates were removed by the publisher after a data-entry issue (TPO is out of this task's scope); and 'The Planning Inspectorate will not entertain a challenge to the appointment of any Decision Maker on the basis of this data.'

conditions: The required attribution statement 'Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.' is carried in every copy of the data and its documentation.
The dataset is labelled as derived and never presented as the Planning Inspectorate's official product.

Changes are indicated: the dataset ships a row selection (decided s78_core planning-permission-family appeals), counted exclusions, cross-file deduplication, a derived binary label (Allowed vs Dismissed), derived date/calendar features, LPA prior-outcome history features computed strictly from earlier-than-instant decisions, and a validation-instant temporal partition.
The publisher's data caveats are carried through unchanged, including the no-challenge clause about the appointment of decision makers.
Our contribution is dedicated CC0-1.0; the source's OGL v3.0 terms are preserved and carry through unchanged, including the same-licence condition for adapted versions of the source material.
Our code and documentation are MIT.
